issuing_body: 文部科学省初等中等教育局
enforcement_authorities: 文部科学省初等中等教育局
implementation_notes: This is Ver. 2.0 of the guideline, revising the provisional Ver. 1.0 published July 2023. The document explicitly states it does not uniformly prohibit or mandate use of generative AI in schools ('学校現場での生成AIの利活用を一律に禁止したり義務付けたりするものではない'). It serves as reference material for school staff and education boards. No penalties or enforcement mechanisms are specified. Future revisions are anticipated as technology evolves.
